scientific_integrity: Reproducible exhaustive finite face, matching, and signed Lefschetz calculations; explicit mathematical deduction of irreducibility. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The finite computation concerns only the ordinary three-cut complex of the Petersen graph and its rational S5 homology character. It does not establish integral lattice equivalence, general Kneser formulas, or equivariant homotopy classification. Existing nonequivariant sphere counts are not claimed as original; possible equivalent-character literature remains a comparison risk.
title: An irreducible \(S_5\)-module in the Petersen three-cut complex
